description: Proposed upstream edits to OSM relation 4256077 (首都高速中央環状線). The relation is role-less, so graph-builder derives the inner/outer carriageway split from the verified-bound C2 ramp evidence, which labels 2,296 of 2,479 mainline edges and leaves the walk in 9 inner and 7 outer runs. Applying this file to a copy of the snapshot does not change the release fixture; it is the candidate changeset the diagnostics are verified against (scripts/apply-osm-relation-repairs.py, docs/c2-route-design.md 段11).
humanReviewRequired: The setMemberRole entries are derived from the current derived split. scripts/audit-c2-carriageway-labels.py re-derives them from the official ramp directions plus geometry, with the junction search validated against the six junction nodes of the three authored pairs (20 anchors placed, 0 conflicts).

The derived split mislabels the outer carriageway as inner for 101 edges in the 王子 to 江北 stretch: 44209387 (3), 780870438 (64) and 44211094 (34). The anchored inner chain (滝野川 inner entry -> 156344609 -> 44289390 -> 28127324) runs westbound and joins the westbound chain 44180277 -> 28127449 -> 44211322 -> 44209384 at node n:308931779, so the eastbound chain that starts 10 m away at n:263988137 is the other carriageway. Geometry, the deck layer at 江北 and the destination tag of 44211094 all agree.
Those ways must therefore not be given an Inner directions role. Fix the split first (docs/c2-route-design.md 段12c); the roles are written from the corrected labels.
No shipped C2 pair crosses the stretch, so the release data is unaffected today.

diagnostics: Removing only the JCT link members stops the walk at n:8283617223 and the builder reports the node, the continuing edge e:w891237687:2:f, and member way 44180278.
Splitting the interior-continuation ways alone leaves the membership unchanged, because the C2 runs are cut by edge labels, not by member order.
Roles plus removals plus splits build, reduce the runs, and add five unique arcs; the first-exit-eligible arc count stays at 11.
